visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera focuses on a sleek silver laptop sitting on a metallic cylindrical stand in a brightly lit indoor showroom. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the laptop's metallic texture. No people are visible initially. (2) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a fuzzy beige coat and white inner top, appears holding the laptop closed. She smiles warmly at the camera, gesturing towards the device's lid with her hands. Other people and laptops are visible in the blurred background. (3) A close-up shot shows the laptop being opened on a wooden-texture table, revealing a gray keyboard and a lit screen with a Windows login interface. (4) The woman is shown in a medium shot, typing on the laptop and looking into the camera with a surprised facial expression, eyes wide. (5) A transition shows a different dark blue laptop with distinctive white geometric lines on its lid (Zenbook S13 OLED style). (6) A top-down view of the laptop's internal hardware is displayed, showing copper heat pipes, fans, and circuit boards. (7) The woman holds a small pink computer mouse, sliding its cover off to reveal the battery compartment and a scent pad. She looks directly at the camera with an enthusiastic smile. (8) She gives a thumbs-up to the camera while holding the pink mouse, ending with a joyful expression in a well-lit indoor space.
